⏺ The endpoints the refresh touches:
┌──────────────┬───────────────────────────┐
│ path         │ what it does              │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┤
│ /refresh     │ rotates the token         │
│ /revoke      │ ends all its tokens       │
